items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: So Chubby hooked me up with his son, Duffy, and we started a little group together with Duffy.

ctx.x: Do you remember the first paying gig you ever had and how much you made?
Yeah. I was doing the Chubby — you know Chubby Jackson, right?
